method: Repository-wide static inventory of retained lifecycles, history-sensitive flag protocols, artifact workflows, UI interaction families and auxiliary parser/traversal automata.

excluded: test/demo/challenge/proof application fixtures and authoring/evaluation programs

interpretation: Symbolic transition names reconstruct control flow; they are not all stored/API enum values.
Named labels, inferred state, derived outcomes and orthogonal axes are distinguished; counts are a grouping choice, not a count of every boolean combination.
Only metadata/source anchors were verified. Related test files were located, not rerun or claimed to cover all transitions.
A static inventory is not formal reachability, race-freedom, or an exhaustive proof over dynamically loaded plugins.

machines.name: Owned invocation and cleanup
machines.transitions: queued → running → done/failed; abort → cancelling; unfinished work → draining → cancelled/failed/done
machines.guard: AbortSignal, child/pending/resource/cleanup sets and drain deadline all influence the terminal result.
machines.recovery: A drain timeout retains cleanupIncomplete and outcome=unknown; persisted live records can later be interrupted.
machines.orthogonalState: state × aborted × cleanup completeness × owner
machines.evidence: Static source inspection; symbolic states are explanatory unless quoted as stored labels.

machines.name: Background job wrapper and recovery
machines.transitions: absent → running → done/failed/cancelled; dead-process live record → interrupted
machines.guard: Deduplicate running key within owner scope; cancellation cannot let a late promise publish a done result.
machines.recovery: cancel changes job state immediately; execution cleanup remains a separate machine. Large results may be reference-only until hydrated.
machines.orthogonalState: job.state × execution.state × result hydrated
machines.evidence: Static source inspection; symbolic states are explanatory unless quoted as stored labels.
